exclusions.source_text: Active malignancy defined as histologically confirmed diagnosis within last 6 months or received any cancer directed therapy within the last 6 months.
Total bilirubin ≤ institutional upper limit of normal (ULN)
Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-infected participants on effective anti-retroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months are eligible for this trial.
exclusions.threshold: undetectable viral load on ART within 6 months

exclusions.source_text: Participants with acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndrome or who are undergoing or have undergone allogeneic stem cell transplant.
Participants with luminal gastrointestinal malignancy or genitourinary cancer.
Presence of known or prior brain metastasis, given the increased risk of life-threatening intracranial hemorrhage with anticoagulant use.
Participants receiving any medications or substances that are inhibitors or inducers of CYP3A/P-gp are ineligible.
Severe renal disease (CKD Stage IV or higher) or liver disease (Child Pugh B/C)
Severe renal disease (CKD Stage IV or higher) or liver disease (Child Pugh B/C)
Pregnant women are excluded from this study because apixaban has the potential for teratogenic or abortifacient effects.
breastfeeding should be discontinued if the mother is treated with apixaban.
